scope: All32 fixed selected initial target poses; CPU mesh geometry only; original five-view raw physical IDs checked only for flagged targets. No current model predictions used.

method.source_vertices: Visible default/render-purpose USD Mesh points including instance proxies; child transform relative to default asset root; explicit runtime applied root scale; float64-normalized saved wxyz rotation; saved position_local in meters
method.flag_rule: Whole target mesh maximum z is strictly below drawer floor top AND target mesh XY bounds lie entirely inside floor XY bounds. This is a preexisting complete burial flag; partial contact penetration and ordinary object occlusion are not flagged.
method.limitations: Geometry reconstruction is not cooked-convex contact replay or comprehensive scene-quality validation. Unflagged does not certify full physical validity. No scene is excluded/replaced and policy performance is not retuned.

layouts.raw_id_check: source raw physical-ID maps directly normalized; five views
